_read_me: The answer table: every non-model request Claude Code makes on its way up,
and what this proxy sends back instead of letting it reach Anthropic.
A machine has ONE launch shape now (结论 46), so this table is the only
thing that gets a screen to a prompt on a deployment that owns no
subscription at all — and the only thing standing between a sandbox and an
echo of the platform account's uuid, email and organization.
Data, not prose, because it has two readers: cheese_billing_core.py serves
it, and cli/e2e's claudee2e suite scripts a stand-in Anthropic API from it
so a REAL Claude Code process boots under exactly these answers. That test
records every non-model path the real client asks for and fails on any that
is not answered 2xx here — which is how a row missing from this table is
found before production finds it, a missing row being a request that goes
upstream on the platform's credential.
Placeholders: {project} and {topic} come from the caller's VERIFIED scoped
token, {rc_flags} expands to rc_flags below for a session whose token grants
the Cheese RC transport and to {} for one that does not.
Rows are matched in order, and `hosts` is checked FIRST on every one of
them: a row answers only the hosts it names, and a row that names none
answers api.anthropic.com alone. That is not a formality — this proxy also
MITMs console.anthropic.com and platform.claude.com, where interactive
Claude Code's login and refresh ask for these same paths and must reach the
real Anthropic. Then `exact` matches the path (query stripped), `prefix`
matches its start, and a row with neither answers every path on its hosts.
A body of null is sent as an empty body.
